description: This file defines the Proxy class in the GuzzleHttp library, providing static methods for wrapping request handlers to facilitate synchronous and streaming request processing.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: Provides static methods to create combined request handlers for synchronous and streaming requests.

methods.name: wrapSync
methods.description: Creates a handler that directs requests to a default or synchronous handler based on the options, enabling synchronous request execution.

methods.name: wrapStreaming
methods.description: Creates a handler that directs requests to either a default or streaming handler based on the options, supporting optimized streaming responses.
